start.text: Petrol, for what? Buy the scooter first - Noor's, next door. Then come, I'll fill it.

owner_start.text: Full tank, three-fifty. Hundred rupees worth, if it's that kind of month. Check the air also, free.

full.text: Full. Zero the meter - see, I zeroed it. Air is fine. Go.

hundred.text: Hundred. Enough for the office and back twice, if you don't race the autos.

bye.text: Looking is free. Petrol is not.
